objective: Slide an exact fixed-size integer window with constant auxiliary storage and noncoercing validation.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: Running-window aggregation and validation remain current.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Fixed-window maxima are useful sequence analysis.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Exact bounds, initialization and ownership transfer.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: Small bounded integers isolate the sliding-window objective.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Zero initialization, coercion or mutation can produce plausible wrong results.

defects: Junior re-added every window, contradicting the desired O(n) time.
Senior sliced k values, contradicting constant auxiliary space.
Floating arithmetic assumptions, ownership and the exact k domain were unstated.
rationale: Keep the correct reference, replace junior with an entering/leaving single scan, and replace senior's slice/reduce initialization with an indexed sum. Define <=2000 integer values within +/-1e6 so all intermediate sums are exact. k must be a positive primitive Number integer within length; reject other values before element access without coercion. Three assertions cover source/frozen ownership, negative/tied/full windows, fifteen invalid kinds including symbols/BigInt/hostile coercion against an element trap, exhaustive short ternary windows and the2e9 total boundary. An independent rolling implementation passes actual worker/base25; a source reverser is rejected under the explicit preservation policy. No TypeScript cases apply.

objective: Find a monotone predicate boundary with a bounded logarithmic number of valid queries across safe integers.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: Binary search and safe integer arithmetic remain current.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Invariants, callback contracts and overflow-safe midpoints transfer.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: A monotone Boolean callback keeps the search objective focused.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Bitwise truncation or unsafe sums can query invalid builds or never terminate.

defects: Senior used a32-bit shift that breaks beyond the signed32-bit range.
Reference/junior and the hint added low+high without a safe integer bound.
Empty ranges, callback arity/receiver/errors and query budget were unspecified.
rationale: Use low+floor((high-low)/2) in all boards and the hint. Define n=0..MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, monotone synchronous Boolean callbacks, only one valid in-range argument/plain receiver, exact thrown identity and zero empty queries. Enforce <=ceil(log2(n+1))+1 calls for n>0. Three hidden assertions cover all2144 size/threshold pairs for n1..64, safe-integer extrema/first/middle/last/no boundary,2^32-1 and thrown identity. An independently authored zero-based lower-bound search passes. The initial old-shift negative hit timeout through an unguarded large callback; add the same specified query-range/budget guard there so it fails promptly, then rerun all six task candidates at the final hash. No timing-based Big O claim or TypeScript cases apply.
